description.narrative:
Stakeholder effects: Increased availability of climate finance. The proposed Project will support access to climate finance, leveraging SBSA's market position and substantial reach. The growth of SBSA's green assets and renewable energy portfolio is expected to avoid GHG emissions.
Stakeholders Effects: Increased access to housing finance. The Project will support access to affordable housing finance. South Africa is rapidly urbanizing, and an estimated 26 percent of the urban population lives in informal housing areas. The Project will increase the supply of housing finance for the affordable housing segment in South Africa.
Contribution to Market Creation Sustainability: IFC anticipates that its systematic engagement at both the sectoral and financial institutions levels, through investments, upstream, and advisory services, will help scale-up climate finance, strengthen green finance standards in the country, and encourage replication by other institutions in South Africa; thus, contributing towards increased environmental sustainability through the demonstration and capacity building channels.

The proposed project consists of a senior unsecured loan to The Standard Bank of South Africa Limited (SBSA or the Bank) to support the Banks renewable energy and affordable housing finance program in South Africa.
